limited-by-design: Not merchandise. Limited objects of identity, made in deliberate numbers and kept forever.
what-we-believe: Recognised without needing to announce itself.

NEVMA began as music: a London label releasing every month, and Moments, the nights built around it. Style is the third pillar. It carries the same sign off the stage and into everyday life, in pieces made so rarely that each one is known by its number.
a-word-you-can-wear: is a gesture, a nod, a sign given with the eyes. The first drop printed that definition as it stands in the dictionary, and it became the house signature: say little, mean it.
Some pieces appear first at a NEVMA Moment, in the room, for the people who were there. What is left goes online afterwards. The archive says where each one began.
how-a-piece-is-made: One sign, one story, often from a release or a Moment.
[Workshop] cuts and finishes the samples until one is right.
Five pieces per colour are made, across sizes. Never more.
Each piece is numbered and signed by hand when it is packed.
Sold out is not the end: the piece stays here with its story.
materials-and-makers: [Short paragraph on the workshops NEVMA works with: where they are, how long they have worked, what they are best at. Real names and places once NEVMA confirms them.]
three-pillars-one-identity: Original music every month, distributed worldwide.
More than events: music, place and light as one experience.
You are here. Limited objects of identity.

care: Limited does not mean final. You can return any piece within 14 days of delivery.
Tell us within 14 days from the day it arrives: from your account, or by writing to client care with your order number.
Send it back within 14 more days, unworn, with its label and numbered card.
We refund the piece and your original delivery cost to the same card through Viva, within 14 days of receiving it.
What happens to a returned piece
It goes back on sale with its number, and the edition counter goes up by one. We say so on the piece: “returned, checked, back in the edition”.
Because there are only five of each piece, we can’t promise another size. Return the piece, then buy the size you want if it’s still available.
Write to us with a photo. We cover return postage and refund or repair, whatever you prefer. Your rights under UK consumer law are not affected.
